phase_goal: Serialize inspection runs (one at a time) with a persistent, transparent, operator-manageable queue.
expected_deliverable: Local application that runs inspections on different ecommerce websites, helps fix the issues it finds, and generates an executive-ready report showing platform issues, suitable for sending to executive leadership and potential monetization. The Inspection Report remains the canonical evidence artifact the application is built around.

validation_gate.reason: GEN-021 (Site>Run>Results UI restructure) validated with two independent clean passes (VAL-069) plus the holistic UI review gate; BDD inventory refreshed to BDD-INV-010. Phase exit declared. No inspection runs triggered.

operator_decisions.summary: Ferosh decided 1A (retain all raw evidence per inspection by default), 2A (ratify timestamp-based inspection IDs), and 3A (Level 2 maturity gates broad Shopify inspections; Level 3 rendered capture gates non-Shopify or heavily rendered storefronts). Recorded in the validation strategy as operator_decisions_2026_07_14.

next_recommended_action: GEN-021 exited. The operator runs inspections via the UI as needed (no-auto-run directive standing). Candidates for the next charter: per-site health summary on site cards, grouping run history/comparison under a site, validator robustness when no runs exist on disk, and non-Shopify adapter groundwork. Charter phase goal + validation strategy before implementing; run the holistic UI review gate before requesting review.
